**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** Continues its 1956-founding exclusive focus: articles, article-length reviews, and Spanish translations of significant foreign-language articles, all centered on Augustine of Hippo's life, works, thought, and influence (patristics/theology/philosophy of religion). Recent annual output per Dialnet-derived counts: ~11 items (2025), 22 (2024), 21 (2023), 23 (2022) - stable small quarterly volume.

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** historical-theological analysis of Augustine's texts, philosophical/doctrinal commentary on Augustinian thought, translations into Spanish of previously published foreign-language Augustine scholarship, book reviews/review articles on Augustinian-studies publications
